about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client, an established property development group in Malta with over 35 years of industry experience and an extensive portfolio of residential developments. With a strong focus on quality, sustainability and contemporary living, the group continues to expand, and is looking for a hands-on Residential Finishing Projects Manager based in Kirkop.

You will oversee the finishing stages of multiple residential developments, making sure workmanship meets the approved drawings and specifications, that projects stay within budget and on programme, and that clients are satisfied at handover. You will coordinate main contractors, subcontractors and building trades, prepare BOQs, trade cost estimates and programmes of works, and measure and certify completed works.
This is a full-time, on-site leadership role for someone who enjoys spending most of the working day on site and seeing developments through to completion. The salary is €50,000–€60,000 per year.
